enable_self_reg.description:i18n: Allows users to register themselves on the site. If not selected, only portal managers can add new users.

enable_user_pwd_choice.title:i18n: Let users select their own passwords
enable_user_pwd_choice.description:i18n: If not selected, a password is not set when users register themselves; they have to reset it.

use_email_as_login.title:i18n: Use email address as login name
use_email_as_login.description:i18n: Allows users to login with their email address instead of specifying a separate login name.
